title.narrative: NATIONAL PHASE-OUT OF METHYL BROMIDE (PHASE II)

description.narrative: The objective of the project is to phase-out 272.5 ODP tonnes (up to 320 ODP tonnes), equivalent to 454 MT ( up to 534 metric tonnes) presently used by the melon and watermelon sectors. Through the implementation of this project, Guatemala will completely replace MB consumption for uses controlled under the Montreal Protocol, bringing the country into full compliance with the total phase out scheduled for 2015. (144 Mt equivalent to 86 ODP tonnes corresponds to quota Multinational Corporation, currently use is 118 Mt equivalent to 71 ODP)
